goal: Every registered item in the actual 1.21.1 NeoForge pack has a positive EMC value, except a short, explicit approved low-value exception list.
coverage_target: 100% of actual item registry, less approved cheap-glass exceptions and untransmutable task/decree documents
valuation_sources: ProjectE native custom_emc.json file (not unverified KubeJS ProjectE addons)
manual audited overrides for recipe-less boss drops/materials
future verified universal-EMC addon only if owner approves it
exception_policy: Owner-approved zero-EMC exceptions: original glass panes plus Bountiful's two task/document item types (bountiful:bounty and bountiful:decree). Bountyboard is not excluded. All other missing values remain reportable errors.
balancing_and_hazards: Compute value of every acquired/craftable item at its least-cost reproducible route; resolve cycles and refund exploits.

Boss trophies and high-tier materials should have positive EMC under universal coverage; after learning they can be transmuted, so boss-as-ingredient gates are one-time unlocks per community, NOT kill checks.
Ore blocks must not receive values that produce infinite EMC via Silk Touch, Fortune, crushing, processing, or resale.
NBT/data-bearing and charged containers must be assessed: plain item-ID EMC values do not prove safe handling of contents, attributes, enchantments or stored resources.
Item variants, durability, spawn eggs, creative/debug artifacts and dynamic loot still appear in coverage census for review; no undocumented exclusions.
Ensure large values fit ProjectE's signed-long/mapper limits; complex Project Expansion EMC BigInteger values may require special policy and native compatibility.
EMC-to-Quest Shop currency economy should be tested for unintended self-amplifying loops.

Never give a generic EMC price to Bountiful signed decree or generated bounty slips; their component-bearing contents and contracts must not be replicated by ProjectE. Verify zero EMC for default and personalized stacks in runtime.
success_gate: Export real loaded item registry and post-mapping positive EMC table, compare, assign missing root values, rerun until zero non-exception misses, then test acquisition/transmutation and no-positive-cycle exploits in Prism.
